per_view.notes: Very long slender grey tube with blunt ends. Small partial hump at nose with dots. Window squares run the full deck. Wing is a thin dark sliver; two boxy nacelles hang near the belly. Tail shows only a wire-thin diagonal line and a stub, no solid fin or tailplane. Single nose wheel plus a clustered wheel bunch; monochrome grey.

Slender grey tube with partial front hump bearing upper-deck windows and a main-deck window row. Wings read as thin flat slabs edge-on, no visible dihedral. Only two boxy nacelles visible, close under the belly. Tail has just a needle-thin diagonal line, no tall swept fin. Nose gear strut plus a small wheel cluster; blunt tail, no upswept cone.

Head-on: round grey fuselage disc with dark cockpit-like arc on top. Four dark nacelles slung under dihedral wings, plausible spacing. Vertical fin reads as a bare thin pole; tailplanes are faint short lines. Nose gear plus only two main struts visible. Coherent grey scheme; fuselage length/taper not assessable from this angle.

Rear head-on: circular fuselage cross-section, four nacelles under high-dihedral thin slab wings with plausible spacing. Vertical fin is a bare thin stick; no horizontal stabilizers visible. Small hump-like lighter shape atop fuselage. Three small gear struts with tiny wheels. Uniform flat grey, no windows, doors, or livery detail.

Top-down: slender grey tube with rounded nose, front-quarter upper-deck outline with dark cockpit windows, dashed window lines both sides. Wings render as chord-less thin lines; four dark nacelles sit at plausible swept positions but appear to float without visible pylons or wing surface. Small paired dark blocks float near mid-fuselage. Tail surfaces are wire-thin; no planform area.

Slender tube with flat unclipped rear end, no tail cone. Front hump with upper-deck windows and main-deck window line present. Wings are thin stick-like slabs; two of four cylinder nacelles float detached right of fuselage. No tall vertical fin visible, only thin sticks at tail. Small wheels under belly. Uniform gray scheme.

Slender grey tube with blunt flat ends, no nose or tail taper. Front-third half-cylinder hump present but unblended. Wings are razor-thin swept slabs; only ~3 nacelles visible, one appears detached. Vertical fin is a bare rod; tailplane a thin sliver. Nose gear plus two main bogies visible. Even window dot line; monochrome grey scheme.

Slender grey tube with flat unfaired disc nose. Partial front hump present with its own window row but open/dark at its front edge. Wings are thin stick-like slabs, no taper or dihedral; nacelles small, attachment unclear, one appears detached. Tail is crude thin sticks. Tiny floating wheels. Main-deck window line is consistent. Monochrome grey livery.

critic.fix_suggestion: Improve 'Empennage (tall vertical stabilizer + horizontal stabilizers)' (mean 3.13/10). Target the 8 anchor: single tall swept vertical stabilizer plus swept horizontal stabilizers at the tail cone, plausible sizes; then the 10 anchor: correct 747 empennage: very tall swept fin, low-mounted swept tailplane pair with dihedral, all tapered and proportioned to the fuselage.
